7055.title: Tasks list settlement stalls on cached route changes
7055.rootCauseOneLine: A reused Tasks list skips settling the first render of a new route, then waits for query dependencies that can remain unchanged in cache.
7055.proposedFix: Key the list by All, Active, or project identity and remove the obsolete cross-route settlement gate; verify cached data without refresh completion plus pending and failed destinations.
7055.caveats: Reproduced using the actual Tasks panel and SDK query cache in jsdom in two trusted checkouts. Browser capture was blocked by missing Chrome/Chromium and no desktop instance; no dependency was installed. Desktop transport and the installed release were not exercised. Reproduction patch and output are inline in the report.
